$comment: Golden vectors for the DiscoveryPresence rule: online iff lastOnline is later than lastOffline (or lastOffline is null); null for anything that is not a presence document. Consumed by contracts/src/discovery-presence-rule.test.ts (presenceIsActive with zod AND discoveryPresenceActive without it, which must agree) and by the OS shell's PODS/POD.THIN/OS/DataBus/presence/discovery-presence.test.js through the generated browser bundle. A reader that answers any of these differently is restating the rule.

cases.why: came up and never went down
never online: a document is not a sighting
equal stamps: later means strictly later
instants, not strings: '.5' sorts before '.25' as text and after it as time
seconds are optional in the stamp grammar
an offset is not the contract's stamp: UTC with Z only
a space is not a T
unix seconds belong to presence.ts's online_since, not here
a missing key is not a presence document
strict: identity never rides on this document
a v1 DeviceRecord is not presence, whatever its status says
